blocks.body:
Agivant’s Glean practice builds domain accelerators natively on the Work AI platform, so the assistant employees already open answers the specialized questions their function runs on, with results in days and weeks.

Built on Glean’s Enterprise Graph, Glean Agents, and Glean Chat, Agivant adds domain ontology, coordinated agent teams, and workflow embedding across assurance, marketing, engineering, documentation, design, and insurance, wherever a general answer stops short of a decision.

Glean covers the horizontal work of the whole enterprise. Agivant goes vertical inside it, adding the depth a single function needs without asking anyone to open a second application.

blocks.quote: Enterprise AI is entering a new phase where organizations are moving beyond experimentation toward operational AI systems that can drive real business outcomes at scale. Our collaboration with Glean enables enterprises to combine Work AI with scalable AI engineering, agentic architectures, and enterprise-grade operational frameworks to accelerate intelligent automation and AI adoption across the enterprise.
blocks.authorRole: Chief Digital Delivery Officer, Agivant Technologies

data.heading: Get Amp’d to move from enterprise search to domain decisions on Glean.
data.description: A domain stack earns its keep in production. Amp’d is how Agivant gets there. Bolt scaffolds the agent stack, Forward Deployed Engineers build inside the enterprise’s own Glean instance, and production grade agents reason over the Enterprise Graph the company already trusts. Each engagement ships with evaluation and rollback, and every hardened domain stack becomes a reusable asset the next build starts from. Every build amplifies the next.

data.heading: Domain accelerators, built natively on Glean.

blocks.title:
Business Assurance
Intelligence
blocks.body: Find the leakage while it is still worth recovering.
blocks.challenge: Assurance teams sample a slice of transactions and reconstruct the rest after the quarter closes, so control breaks and revenue leakage surface long after the money moved.
blocks.solution: Coordinated agents read transaction, policy, and control data where it sits, quantify value at risk with the derivation attached, and route each finding to the owner who can act on it.

blocks.title:
Marketing
Intelligence
blocks.body: Settle the spend question with one version of the numbers.
blocks.challenge: Marketing and finance teams debate attribution models and campaign efficacy across siloed channels, leaving spend decisions ungrounded in reconciled revenue impact.
blocks.solution: Marketing agents synthesize cross-channel metrics, unify attribution logic on the Enterprise Graph, and provide decision-makers with a single, verifiable version of performance numbers.

blocks.title:
Autonomous Technical
Documentation
blocks.body: Documentation that keeps pace with the release train.
blocks.challenge: Engineering ships changes faster than technical writers can update documentation, causing stale guides, broken integration references, and escalated support volume.
blocks.solution: Documentation agents monitor code repositories, pull requests, and API schemas to generate, verify, and publish synchronized technical documentation automatically.

blocks.title:
Engineering
Productivity Intelligence
blocks.body: See where cycle time actually goes.
blocks.challenge: Engineering leaders lack granular visibility into true cycle time bottlenecks across code review, CI/CD pipelines, and environment provisioning, relying on anecdotal metrics.
blocks.solution: Productivity agents trace development telemetry end-to-end, identifying friction points, idle pull requests, and test suite delays to optimize team throughput.

blocks.title:
Design & Simulation
Support Intelligence
blocks.body: Stop paying twice for a simulation someone already ran.
blocks.challenge: Product engineering teams repeatedly re-run expensive computational simulations and design evaluations because historical outputs are locked in individual workstations or obscure folders.
blocks.solution: Simulation agents catalog, index, and surface prior design simulations, parameters, and results within Glean Chat so engineers never duplicate costly compute runs.

blocks.title:
Insurance
Intelligence Hub
blocks.body: Read the submission against the policy wording, every time.
blocks.challenge: Underwriters and claims adjusters manually review complex multi-page policy wordings, endorsements, and loss histories under strict turnaround deadlines, increasing coverage error risk.
blocks.solution: Insurance intelligence agents cross-reference submissions against policy clauses, underwriting guidelines, and regulatory filings in seconds to deliver auditable decision matrices.

data.heading: Keep judgment with the people who own the outcome.
data.description: Every Agivant agent on Glean is production grade from day one, observable and always on. Agents assemble the evidence and state the recommendation, and the underwriter, the analyst, or the engineer makes the call with the reasoning in front of them. Routine retrieval and reconciliation run on their own, while anything carrying money or regulatory weight routes for human approval first.
data.closingStatement: All of it runs inside the Glean instance the enterprise already trusts.
